text:
anya: Quick sync — spotted a few docs-to-console frictions and a help-drawer a11y issue. Dropping short list so UX/docs/eng can triage.

jess: pls bullet.

anya: bullets:
- Label mismatch: console form shows 'model alias' but docs use 'pinned model' (confusing in rollout guide)
- Inline help inconsistency: some panels include full how-to, others show 1-line + link
- Toast CTAs land at top of docs with no anchor/utm
- Help drawer a11y: ESC sometimes no-op; focus not restored to trigger

mike: for anchors/analytics propose pattern: /docs/{slug}#{section-id}?utm_source=console&utm_medium=cta. Keep payload small.

olivia: UX preference: inline = 1-sentence summary + single CTA "Read more" (modal) ; external link = "Open docs" (new tab).

tom: accessibility repro (short): open route -> ? help -> tab links inside drawer -> press ESC -> drawer stays open. Suggest role="dialog" and aria-modal="true", set focus to first interactive element, ensure ESC calls same close handler as the X.

docs-bot: creating issue RED-4001 for term mapping + anchor list, attaching CSV template.

a11y-bot: also recommend restoring visible focus outlines and adding a simple SR announcement on open: "Help panel opened".

anya: next steps (short):
1) P0: fix help-drawer ESC/focus (eng)
2) P1: canonicalize 'Pinned model' term + SDK migration note (docs/SDK)
3) P2: add stable anchors + UTM scheme (docs/eng)
4) P3: inline-summary pattern + Figma frames (UX)

jess: i'll post copy snippets in this thread today.

mike: i'll add a minimal telemetry event for CTA clicks and an e2e asserting ESC closes the drawer and focus returns.

anya: thanks all :thumbsup:
